title: Specified framework/PBC open-exchange comparison data
statement: For an open compactification diagram and a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω/Q_l, and the recorded coefficient-comparison system S, define the specified integral/raw-field/common-stage comparison data as follows. Use S's actual integral equivalences, raw rational equivalences and pair functors. Integral support is the given framework strict-quotient/Roos compact-support functor on one side and the actual PBC proper image after open extension on the other; integral pullback is the recorded framework and strict completed PBC pullback. A comparison has four natural isomorphisms b_f,b_f',a_v,a_u with those endpoints. Normalize b by the existing projection-normalized qcqs realization, the specified completed-ring restriction and the unique open-adjunction comparison. Normalize a by the existing quotient-coordinate/zero-shifted-coordinate chain map and the ordinary-to-completed quotient unit, followed by the unique strict/reflector comparison. Supply the coefficient-square equality for the actual ring maps. Fix the framework exchange by the proper mate followed by the open mate on the entire strict tower, total derived limit and the canonical endpoints; fix the PBC exchange to the ordered completedCompactSupportExchange for the principal uniformizer ideal. At raw rational stages all four isomorphisms and both exchanges are the actual localizations of the integral maps. Their families satisfy the mixed beta equations, including repeated coefficient stages and associators, and their pair maps are descended with the specified composition isomorphisms. Define S_K as a_v followed by P_v(b_f), T_K as b_f' followed by F_f'(a_u), and the comparison-square predicate as S_K followed by Ex_pbc equals J(Ex_sf) followed by T_K. The global pullback data retain the actual identity/composition equations and agree with S on every scheme isomorphism. Canonical pullback-square comparisons are specified by the whole-system compositors on the framework side and by the ordinary-square/quotient-unit equation on the PBC side. A square packet bundles these existing operations and normalization data, without asserting exchange invertibility or changing any category. The constituent notions are [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-algebraic-closure], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-pc-fibre-product], [def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport], [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], [pqf-def-locnoeth], [def-zl-compactification-open-diagram], [def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum], [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum], [def-fd-finite-pullback-comparison-datum], [def-cbc-normalized-coefficient-families], [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action], [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], [lem-cbc-complete-proetale-strict-tower-realization]. The framework arrow is precisely [def-zl-framework-open-exchange], independently of the presentation comparison and of S_K and T_K.
